data_fields.name: acceptRejectList
data_fields.donor_constant: Reject set and Except set per trait; empty Reject denies all not excepted

data_fields.name: ownerRequired
data_fields.donor_constant: owner or owner's bot controller only; no-owner accepted by the donor

best_idea: Before any fight command changes state, the server checks that the sender controls the fighter, that the fighter is alive, and that the fighter's current state accepts that command, with every check in one short ordered list.
decision_why: Frankendom's server must check that the sender owns the hero before a duel input, and the per-state accept list belongs in data rather than ad hoc ifs in the duel step; do not copy the donor's no-owner accept.
acceptance: A server test asserts that an input naming a hero the sender does not own changes nothing; a dead hero ignores input; a state whose accept list refuses attack drops that input and keeps the rest of the state; a hero with no owner is refused, not accepted.
